settings.heading: Settings
settings.show_progress_help: Shows how far through a tour the reader is, next to the buttons.
settings.allow_close_help: Lets the reader leave a tour early, with a close button and the Escape key. The tour is still marked as taken.
settings.show_in_settings_label: List tours on the member's settings page
settings.show_in_settings_help: Lets members start a tour again themselves, instead of asking a moderator to reset it.

tours.heading: Tours
tours.import_done: Tour imported. It arrives switched off, so look it over before turning it on.
tours.import_invalid: That file is not a tour export.
tours.preview_navigate: Opened the forum. Go to a {route} page and the preview starts there.
tours.step_count: {count, plural, =0 {no steps} one {# step} other {# steps}}

steps.heading: Steps in {title}
steps.none: No steps yet, so this tour does not run.
steps.no_target: Shown on its own, in the middle of the screen

flags.clicks_target: Clicks this element on the way to the next step
flags.advance_on_click: The reader clicks this element to continue
flags.translated: Translated into {count, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}}

stats.heading: How it is doing
stats.none: Nobody has been through this tour yet.
stats.dropoff_help: The step each person was on when they left. Only counts people who left early.

tour_modal.title_help: For your reference. Members never see it.
tour_modal.key_help: Identifies the tour in exports and in links. Leave it alone once members have taken it.
tour_modal.start_mode_help: A tour that starts on its own runs once for each member who matches it. A manual one waits to be launched from their settings page.
tour_modal.route_help: The Flarum route this tour belongs to, such as index or discussion. Leave it empty for a tour anchored to the header, which follows the member around.
tour_modal.audience_help: Leave every group unticked to show it to everybody.
tour_modal.max_age_help: In days. Leave it empty to show the tour whatever the account's age.
tour_modal.delete_confirmation: Delete this tour, its steps, and the record of who has taken it?

step_modal.description_placeholder: What you want the reader to know
step_modal.description_help: Formatted the same way a post is on this forum, so links, bold and images work if the extensions for them are on.
step_modal.target_help: The element this step points at. Leave it empty to show the step on its own, in the middle of the screen.
step_modal.target_invalid: That is not a valid CSS selector.
step_modal.target_matches: {count, plural, =0 {Matched nothing on the page you looked at} one {Matched # element} other {Matched # elements}}
step_modal.placement_help: Where the popover sits relative to the element. It moves anyway when there is no room.
step_modal.devices_help: A header selector often has no match on a phone, where the header becomes the drawer.
step_modal.translations_help: Pick a language to write it in. Anything you leave empty falls back to the wording above.
step_modal.clicks_target_label: Click this element on the way to the next step
step_modal.clicks_target_help: Use this to open a menu that a later step points inside.
step_modal.advance_on_click_label: The reader clicks this element to continue
step_modal.advance_on_click_help: Replaces the Next button on this step, and lets the click through to the element.
step_modal.delete_confirmation: Delete this step from the tour?

permissions.reset_tour_guide: Send a member through their tours again

forum.preview_notice: Preview. Nothing you do here is recorded.

settings.none: There are no tours to take.
settings.waiting: Go to the page {title} is about and it will start there.
settings.nothing_here: Nothing on this page for {title}. Try it from the page it belongs to.

picker.picking: Click the element this step points at
